name: ELU+1 · q/k-normalized
tagline: Stabilize positive features by fixing the q/k scale.
description: Registered after the original ELU+1 runs failed: per-head parameter-free RMSNorm of q and k (FP32) with a fixed temperature of 8 precedes the ELU+1 feature map. The state is read without the φ(q)ᵀz denominator and normalized by a per-head RMSNorm with a learned gain. Attention runs in IEEE FP32 so gradients stay accurate when the state is nearly rank one.
paperTitle: Transformers are RNNs: Fast Autoregressive Transformers with Linear Attention
mechanism: S = Σφ(k)vᵀ read as φ(q)ᵀS without a denominator
Per-head output RMSNorm with gain; IEEE FP32 chunked attention
limitations: A native stabilization registered after failures (NormAttention-style output normalization, pre-feature q/k normalization as in ReBased without its learned affine map). Report it together with the failed ELU+1 attempts; its pilot's final numerical check was a documented post-hoc substitution.
